title: cantinoa pinetorum
intro: Cantinoa pinetorum, commonly known as pine mint or pine thyme, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is prized for its essential oils, which offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as aiding in digestion and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cantinoa pinetorum include its antioxidant, expectorant, and antiseptic properties, making it a popular choice for treating coughs, colds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include pinene, thymol, and carvacrol, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
